Trace, implement and test: Concatenate Strings

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_String;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class ConcatenateStrings {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the string");
        String text = sc.nextLine();
        System.out.println("enter the 2nd string");
        String pattern = sc.nextLine();
        System.out.println("The concatenated string is : " + (text + pattern));
        sc.close();
    }

}
